featured_reviews.name: Asad Durrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
These people are scammers. They came claiming to be from Eureka Forbes, took money, and did absolutely nothing. The water purifier was working before their visit. After their “service,” it stopped working completely.
We have been without drinking water for 2 days and had to buy water from outside. No refund, no solution, only cringey attitude.
The complaint desk staff Niti and Priya have zero customer service skills. Rude, careless, and talk as if customers don’t matter.
This is not service. This is cheating and on top of it their cheap attitude..
Eureka Forbes without customers consent shares their numbers to 3rd party conpanies .. They need to train their staff or stop fooling customers.
The Owner and employees blocked our number so they dont have to refund. Cheap.
If we dont get our refund there will be legal consequences..
